user.title: Add Gree unit
user.description: Enter the IP address of the unit. Give it a DHCP reservation in your router so the address stays stable.

data_description.host: The unit must already be on your Wi-Fi (pair it once with the Gree+ or EWPE Smart app).
data_description.port: Leave at 7000 unless you forward the port.

data_description.host: The new IP address or hostname of the unit.
data_description.port: Leave at 7000 unless you forward the port.

connection.name: Connection details
connection.description: Normally set up automatically. Change these only if you know the values are wrong.

data_description.mac: Address used in protocol messages. Leave empty to use the one the unit reports.
data_description.key: 16-character key from pairing. Leave empty to pair again and get a new key.
data_description.cipher: ECB for older firmware, GCM for newer firmware. Ignored when pairing again.

error.cannot_connect: No answer from the unit. Check the IP address and that UDP port 7000 is reachable.
error.cannot_bind: The unit answered but refused to pair. Power-cycle it and try again.
error.invalid_key: The unit is reachable but did not accept the key. Check the key, encryption and MAC address, or leave the key empty to pair again.
error.invalid_key_format: The device key must be exactly 16 characters.
error.invalid_mac: The MAC address must have 12 hexadecimal digits, e.g. f4:91:1e:12:34:56.

abort.not_gree: The discovered device did not respond like a Gree unit.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different unit.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the unit's state. Changes made with the remote show up after at most this long.

command_failed.message: Failed to send command to the Gree unit at {host}: {error}

update_failed.message: Cannot reach the Gree unit at {host}: {error}
